newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TALLINNA LOOKS FOR LITHUANIA BROKERAGE.
newsitem.headline: TALLINNA LOOKS FOR LITHUANIA BROKERAGE.

text.p: Tallinna Pank said it has started negotitations with several brokerages in Lithuania as one possible way to become more active in that country.
"We have started negotiations with a few companies in Lithuania but it is too early to give any names," said Martti Siimann, head of Tallinna Pank's capital markets department.
"This is just one plan we have and there is nothing concrete as yet," he added.
"If we can't buy one, then we will have to build it from scratch," he said.
Tallinna Pank has been active in Lithuania since the start of 1994 and plans to increase its presence by the end of June.
"Our plans for a brokerage in Lithuania are in the short term and we expect something by the end of the first half of the year," he added.
"Our clients have been getting more active in Lithuania and we move quite large volumes, so it would be more stable and profitable it we did it ourselves," he added.
Tallinna Pank has also said that it wants to enter the banking market of Lithuania.
